name: context-panel
title: Context Panel
description: What fills a chat's working memory, adding up to its window: share used, one segmented bar, a legend with tokens and shares, what's free, and Summarize now.

meta.whenToUse: The body of ContextRing's panel, or a Context section in a chat's side panel or a phone sheet.
meta.whenNotToUse: Run cost or usage limits (RunUsage), or upload progress (UploadPanel).
